product_metadata.title: Keurig K-Cup In Room Brewing System, 11.1 x 10-Inches, 8 ounces
features: Single-use Water Reservoir, Brews One 8-ounce Cup
Fits approximately 4.5 inches coffee mug with tray, 5 inches with tray removed
Heat times may vary depending on temperature of water added
Cold water can take 5-7 minutes, while room temperature water can take 3-5 minutes
Not compatible with reusable K cup filters
description: Keurig K-Cup In Room Brewing System. Single-use Water Reservoir that brews 1 - 8 Ounce Cup of coffee. Not compatible with reusable K cup filters. Fits approximately 4.5 inch mug with the tray in place, approximately 5 inch mug if you remove the tray before putting the mug in place. Heat times may vary depending on temperature of water. Cold water can take 5-7 minutes, while room temperature water can take 3-5 minutes. Energy Savings Mode - Automatic On/Off Function. Easy Cleaning and Maintenance. Power: 700 watts
